text:
neha: Quick ask — freezer is full of unlabelled meals. found mystery lasagna. :grimacing:
sam: ugh same. propose simple label: `Name | packed: YYYY-MM-DD | use-by: YYYY-MM-DD`
devon: +1. also add allergen line if it's homemade.
neha: I'll print waterproof labels. Sam can you pick them up today?
sam: yep grabbing 3 rolls of freezer labels and a marker. anyone wants snacks?
maya: i'll take a pack of oat cookies.
kitchen-bot: Reminder set — kitchen rota update due. Link: https://tiny.redwood/kitchen-rota
neha: also suggestion: top shelf = labeled meals only. no loose tupperware on bottom.
devon: tiny poll: snack money envelope or honor system? react with :coin: for envelope, :sparkles: for honor system
sam: :coin:
maya: :sparkles:
neha: thanks. will put a sheet on the fridge with the label template and rota signups. last: bake-off Friday signups open.
sam: i'll bring brownies. :cookie:
